sources.missing_policy: '..' is unavailable/suppressed, preserved as null. The workbook says estimates based on fewer than 50 cases are removed; it does not identify the cause of each individual missing cell.
sources.comparability: Country-specific population units, ages and child bands are retained. Some countries' 2021 cells are absent. sources.title: 令和6年 雇用動向調査結果の概況・図表
sources.population: 全国、16大産業に属し常用労働者5人以上の事業所。常用は無期雇用または1か月以上の有期雇用。一般労働者は本調査のパートタイム以外であり、正社員と同義ではない。町の自営業や5人未満店舗を直接代表しない。
sources.missing_policy: Selected flow cells are present. Wage-change total includes unstated responses, so increase/unchanged/decrease need not sum to 100 and must not be renormalized. Wage changes cover former employees still registered at the survey, exclude former self-employed and exclude entrants no longer registered (table 6 note 1).
sources.comparability: 2024 benchmark update: workbook 2023 rows are original published values, not the benchmark-adjusted reference aggregation. Treat 2023/2024 as separately defined contexts, not a clean year-on-year trend.

sources.title: 令和4年 国民生活基礎調査 介護票 第82表 同居の主な介護者数、現在の要介護度・介護時間別
sources.population: 全国の介護保険法上の要支援・要介護認定を受けた在宅の者と、その同居の主な介護者。一般の病気、未認定者、入院・施設入所者の回復過程を代表しない。
sources.missing_policy: All selected CSV values are present. '不詳' is a published care-time category kept in the denominator, not an absent observation. Overall grade includes care-grade-unknown recipients.
sources.comparability: Original unit is per 100000 care recipients, not actual sampled people. Derived within-grade percentages explicitly divide by the co-resident-main-carer total of that grade, with rounding error. 'ほとんど終日' is a qualitative reported category, not 24 hours of continuous hands-on care.
